title: Super useful!!
body:
Works so well for neurodivergent people to help break down tasks, the other features like taskmaster, estimator, and complier also incredibly helpful. However the app is abit glitchy and buggy, sometimes juts struts off or says “error” which is slightly disappointing for a paid app - but I have never had any problems on 
the website version
author: Saturnswingsxx

title: Unusable App
body: It doesn’t allow you to select any options. Just abruptly consistently crashes. Wasted money :-(
author: Soundbyte_

title: Nothings changed since my feedback in July
body:
I was told the bugs would be fixed but it’s just as buggy now as back then. Super disappointed because I bought it to make my life better but it hasn’t helped a bit because the bugs make it almost unusable.
Super sad about the lack of upkeep and care, I e sent an email back in July with no response :/
author: @claudellitjie

title: Love this app, wish it was less buggy
body: My neurodivergent self loves this app. It is however super glitchy, which I wasn’t expecting from an app I have paid for. App often shuts down or force closes, sometimes accompanied by an error code “xxxx could not be completed”
author: ales_bee

title: I love this
body: My goblin brain appreciates this so much
